summary: Branch protection on main reconciled with .shiki/config.yaml. Exactly two fields changed: required contexts 3 -> 4 (added 'MergeGate metadata check') and required_approving_review_count 0 -> 1. Every other field in the protect_branch payload already matched live and was re-asserted unchanged (strict, enforce_admins, dismiss_stale_reviews, require_code_owner_reviews=false per SADR-0021, restrictions=null, required_conversation_resolution, required_linear_history, allow_force_pushes, allow_deletions). Applied by the operator from the payload derived by shiki_config.configured_required_checks / branch_protection_review_count / configured_required_code_owner_review, because the agent's permission classifier denied the live protection write. Safe to require a review: the CCA Review Bridge approved 5 of 5 recent PRs, and PR #354 demonstrated the mandatory-review cycle (review DISMISSED on push, re-APPROVED after the fresh CCA run). Residual risk recorded: enforce_admins is true, so a Review Bridge failure now blocks merges for admins too; rollback is the same payload with required_approving_review_count 0.
